name: Nike Cross Regionals Heartland
where: Sioux Falls, SD · Yankton Trail Park
headline: Nike Cross Regionals Heartland
summary: A Nike Cross Nationals qualifier: the top two teams and top five individuals not on those teams advance. No. 6 Ava Claasen and No. 9 Ruby Ihmels lead the girls race with No. 11 Harrisburg (and No. 16 Brianna Reilly) and No. 17 Pella. No. 27 Sioux Falls Washington and No. 20 Preston Johnson lead the boys. · Girls 2:25 p.m. CT · Boys 2:55 p.m. CT
